name: dsh-composer-ease

scripts.check: node tools/check-size.mjs && node tools/check-dup.mjs && node tools/check-refactor.mjs && node tools/check-release.mjs
scripts.test: node tools/check-size.mjs && node tools/check-dup.mjs && node test/selftest.mjs && node test/server-routes.mjs && node test/client-smoke.mjs && node test/client-behavior.mjs && node test/compliance.mjs
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:docs && npm run check:readme && npm run check:entry && npm run check:privacy && npm run check:prose && npm run check:copies && npm run build -- --check && npm run check:real

description: Composer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: bracket and quote pairing, wrap-on-selection, closer skipping, empty-pair backspace, and a completion popup over draft words, language tables, workspace files and model ids. Full-width brackets typed through a Chinese IME are converted to half-width ().
